reviews.comment:
Vengo por la avenida y al no haber fila entro y me pongo como dice el cartel para cargar y el playero muy maleducado me pide que de toda la vuelta a la manzana y entre si o si por la calle lateral una locuara me fui a la puma de la otra cuadra y me atendieton de 10 no vuelvo mas a esa estasion

(Translated by Google)
I came along the avenue and, since there was no line, I went in and stood where the sign said to fill up. The attendant was very rude and told me to go all the way around the block and enter through the side street—it was crazy! I went to the Puma gas station on the next block and they treated me perfectly. I'm never going back to that station.
